sentences.text: L. Filippi and A. Garrido formally described Pitekunsaurus in 2008.
The species name honors Luis Macaya, an oil company explorer who found the fossil in April 2004.
Pitekunsaurus is classified as an aeolosaurid, a group closely related to the genera Gondwanatitan and Aeolosaurus.
Its braincase closely resembles those of Muyelensaurus, Vahiny, and Jainosaurus.
This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous in the Anacleto Formation of Neuquén, Argentina.
It existed between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
